title: The additive ideal image is the pushforward of the relative additive kernel.
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and J ≤ I quasi-coherent ideal sheaves [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. Write i_J: Z_J → X and j: Z_I → Z_J. For the additive restriction r [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction] and direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], the categorical image of ker(r_I) → A_X → (i_J)_*A_Z_J is isomorphic to (i_J)_* ker(r_j). No nilpotence or square-zero hypothesis is required.

proof.text: Prove additive restriction along a closed immersion is an epimorphism. For an etale test scheme V use its affine open cover. Each base-changed closed immersion into an affine member has a surjective global-functions map by Mathlib IsClosedImmersion.isAffine_surjective_of_isAffine. Lift the restricted section and apply Scheme.ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff and Sheaf.epi_of_isLocallySurjective. This is the affine representative step, without explicitly computing either ideal kernel.

Check composition compatibility of additive restriction with Etale.lowerStarComp, componentwise. After applying the coefficient functor, Scheme.Hom.comp_appTop and MorphismProperty.Over.pullbackComp_left_fst_fst identify the composite pullback projections. Apply IdealSheafData.inclusion_subschemeι to the nested ideals.

Let f be restriction to J, g the pushforward of the relative restriction, k restriction to I, and c the composition isomorphism, so f followed by g followed by c equals k. Lift kernel.ι k followed by f to kernel g. The universal property of kernel k proves that this lift and kernel.ι k form a pullback square over f and kernel.ι g. Abelian.epi_snd_of_isLimit makes the lift epi, and strongEpi_of_epi and image.isoStrongEpiMono identify the displayed image with kernel g.

Compose the image isomorphism with the inverse of PreservesKernel.iso for the pushforward along J.subschemeι. Direct image preserves kernels, so its target is exactly the pushforward of the relative additive kernel in the theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem nonempty_idealAdditiveImageRelativeKernelIso (X : Scheme.{u})
    (I J : X.IdealSheafData) (hJI : J ≤ I) :
    Nonempty (image (kernel.ι (etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar I.subschemeι) ≫
        etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar J.subschemeι) ≅
      (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} J.subschemeι).obj
        (kernel (etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar (IdealSheafData.inclusion hJI))))
